# Design System Reference

Source: SystemSrc/specs/design-system.md (OPTIONAL_HEURISTIC)

## Purpose
Ensures component cohesion and token mapping across the product.

## Guidelines
1. Reuse existing primitive and composite components before creating new ones.
2. Map all custom variants to existing design system primitives.
3. Avoid duplicate component implementations (e.g. multiple Button variants doing the same thing).
